text: Two astronauts blasted off in Gemini 7 for a two week trip around the Earth. Families across the country listened on the radio and cheered them on.
John Glenn became the first American to circle the Earth, riding in a little capsule named Friendship 7. Neighbors gathered around radios and televisions to share the moment.
Alan Shepard rode a rocket high above the clouds and came safely home. Schools let the children listen in, and the whole country felt a little taller.
The Seattle World's Fair opened its gates, with a tall Space Needle, a monorail and crowds in their Sunday best. Visitors came from every state to wander and wonder.
A shiny new car called the Mustang was shown to the public at the New York World's Fair. Young drivers dreamed of a long open road and the radio turned up.
Families sat close together on warm summer evenings as the first people walked on the Moon. Many remember the hush in the room, and then the happy cheering.
